name: GeoLibre Desktop
start: bash -c 'SESSION_NAME=geolibre-dev; PORT=5173; if curl -sf "http://localhost:${PORT}/" >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; if tmux -f /exec-daemon/tmux.portal.conf has-session -t "=${SESSION_NAME}" 2>/dev/null; then tmux -f /exec-daemon/tmux.portal.conf kill-session -t "${SESSION_NAME}"; fi; tmux -f /exec-daemon/tmux.portal.conf new-session -d -s "${SESSION_NAME}" -c /workspace -- bash -lc "npm run dev"; for _ in $(seq 1 60); do if curl -sf "http://localhost:${PORT}/" >/dev/null; then echo "GeoLibre dev server ready at http://localhost:${PORT}/"; exit 0; fi; sleep 2; done; echo "GeoLibre dev server failed to become ready on port ${PORT}" >&2; exit 1'
